map.诉讼时效计算器（中国） 使用指南: Statute of Limitations Calculator (China) User Guide
map.诉讼时效计算器依据《民法典》第188条测算民事诉讼时效起算与届满期间，区分普通与: The statute of limitations calculator uses Article 188 of the Civil Code to work out when the civil limitation starts and expires, distinguishing ordinary and special periods — suitable for debt collection, enforcement-deadline judgement, and legal reminders.
map.填写「最近一次中断日期（如主张权利、起诉等）」。: Enter "Most Recent Interruption Date (claiming the right, filing suit, etc.)".
map.一般民事纠纷适用 3 年普通时效，从知道或应当知道权利受损及义务人之日算起。: Ordinary civil disputes fall under the 3-year limitation, counted from the day you knew or should have known of the harm and the obligor.
map.时效期间内起诉、请求、同意履行等中断，重新计算 3 年。: Filing suit, making a demand, or agreeing to perform during the period interrupts it, and 3 years is recomputed.
map.自权利受损害之日起超过 20 年的，法院不予保护。: A court gives no protection where more than 20 years have passed since the right was harmed.
map.：权利受损害日 2023-03-15，时效自次日起算 3 年，届满 2026-0: : with the right harmed on 2023-03-15, the 3-year period runs from the next day and expires 2026-03-15.
map.：2024-09-01 起诉或书面催告，时效自该日重新计算 3 年，新届满 20: : suit filed or written demand made on 2024-09-01 restarts the 3-year period, so the new expiry is 2027-09-01.
map.哪些请求权不适用 3 年？: Which Claims Are Not Subject to the 3-Year Period?
map.如请求停止侵害、排除妨碍、消除危险、不动产物权返还等，适用特殊时效或不受时效限制: Claims such as requesting cessation of infringement, removing an obstruction, eliminating a danger, or returning immovable property fall under special periods or are not time-barred, as the law provides.
map.20 年最长保护期怎么理解？: How Should the 20-Year Maximum Protection Period Be Understood?
map.从权利受损害之日起算，超过 20 年法院不予保护，即便中间无中断；特殊情形可申请: Counted from the day the right was harmed, a court gives no protection beyond 20 years even without interruption; in special cases an extension may be requested and the court decides.
